description: Header file defining classes and structures for buffer pool management in Android's media codec framework, including C2BufferQueueBlockPool and related data structures, with external references to Android graphics buffer queue interfaces.

classes.name: C2BufferQueueBlockPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of graphic buffer blocks, configured with an allocator and optional Android graphic buffer producer.

classes.name: C2BufferQueueBlockPoolData
classes.description: Holds buffer queue related data, supports migration and buffer management.

methods.name: C2BufferQueueBlockPool
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer pool with allocator and local ID.

methods.name: getAllocatorId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the allocator used.

methods.name: fetchGraphicBlock
methods.description: Fetches a graphic buffer block with specified parameters.

methods.name: setRenderCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked upon buffer rendering.

methods.name: configureProducer
methods.description: Configures the buffer producer interface for block creation.
